metadata.question: Does the surface soil moisture in Utah decrease in August 2020, compare to long-term records for the same month?

data.raw_code: 1. Question: Does surface soil moisture in Utah decrease in August 2020 compared to long-term records for the same month? 2. Strategy: - Use SMAP soil moisture data (NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture) - Compare August 2020 vs long-term August average (e.g., 2015-2019) - Focus on Utah state boundary - Use the 'ssm' band (surface soil moisture) 3. Data Quality Checks: - Check if collections have data - Check if valid pixels exist after masking - Validate soil moisture values are reasonable (0-100 cm³/cm³) 4. Logic: - Calculate mean soil moisture for August 2020 - Calculate mean soil moisture for long-term August (2015-2019) - Compare: if 2020 < long-term average = Yes (A), else No (B) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var utah = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Utah')); var aug2020 = ee.DateRange('2020-08-01', '2020-08-31'); var longTerm = ee.DateRange('2015-08-01', '2019-08-31'); // 2. Data Acquisition var smap = ee.ImageCollection('NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture') .select('ssm'); var aug2020Col = smap.filterBounds(utah).filterDate(aug2020); var longTermCol = smap.filterBounds(utah).filterDate(longTerm); var aug2020Count = aug2020Col.size().getInfo(); var longTermCount = longTermCol.size().getInfo(); print(`2020 August Images: ${aug2020Count}`); print(`Long-term August Images: ${longTermCount}`); // Check for empty collections if (aug2020Count === 0 || longTermCount === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean soil moisture var aug2020Mean = aug2020Col.mean(); var longTermMean = longTermCol.mean(); // Check valid pixels var aug2020Stats = aug2020Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine(ee.Reducer.mean(), null, true), geometry: utah, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var longTermStats = longTermMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine(ee.Reducer.mean(), null, true), geometry: utah, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var aug2020Pixels = aug2020Stats.ssm_count; var longTermPixels = longTermStats.ssm_count; var aug2020SM = aug2020Stats.ssm_mean; var longTermSM = longTermStats.ssm_mean; print(`2020 Valid Pixels: ${aug2020Pixels}, SM: ${aug2020SM ? aug2020SM.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); print(`Long-term Valid Pixels: ${longTermPixels}, SM: ${longTermSM ? longTermSM.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (aug2020Pixels === 0 || longTermPixels === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (aug2020SM === null || longTermSM === null || aug2020SM < 0 || aug2020SM > 100 || longTermSM < 0 || longTermSM > 100) { print("C3"); return; } // Compare soil moisture values if (aug2020SM < longTermSM) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
